title: SUMO Movie: I Love Boosters
description:
Join us in the Weitz Cinema at 7pm for this week's Sumo movie, I Love Boosters. The movie will be shown twice on Friday and Saturday nights at 7pm and 10pm. Closed captioning equipment and assistive listening devices are available for the Friday showings. The Saturday showings will be open-captioned.

This movie is rated R.

Event Details:
https://www.carleton.edu/student/orgs/sumo/

location: Weitz Cinema, Weitz Center for Creativity
